about.title: Belvedere Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Belvedere is a small, tightly wound peninsula community where local streets like Peninsula Road, Bayview Avenue, Graham Avenue, and Beach Road carry residents, cyclists, and visitors alike. Collision counts here are low compared to larger Marin County cities, but when a crash does happen — often on a Friday afternoon as commuters and school traffic overlap — the aftermath can still be disorienting. Medical appointments, insurance calls, and property repairs pile up fast, usually while you're still sore and trying to make sense of what happened. LawProactive doesn't practice law; we simply connect injured drivers, passengers, cyclists, and pedestrians with an independent personal injury attorney who can evaluate the details of a Belvedere crash and explain your options. There's no cost to get connected, and the attorneys in our network only get paid if your claim results in a recovery. Reaching out early helps make sure evidence from the scene isn't lost before it matters.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before Talking to the Insurer

items.title: California's Two-Year Clock
items.desc: You generally have two years from the crash date to file a personal injury lawsuit in California, but that window can shrink to as little as six months if a government entity, like a road maintained by the Town of Belvedere or Marin County, is involved. An attorney can spot that issue early instead of after the deadline has passed.

items.title: Comparative Fault Cuts Both Ways
items.desc: California uses pure comparative fault, so even if you're found partly responsible for the crash, you can still recover damages reduced by your share of fault. Insurers know this and often try to inflate your percentage of blame during recorded statements, which is one reason to have guidance before speaking with them.

items.title: No Cap on Pain and Suffering Damages
items.desc: Unlike some states, California places no cap on non-economic damages like pain, suffering, and loss of enjoyment of life in most car accident cases. An attorney can help make sure those harder-to-quantify losses aren't overlooked when a claim is valued.

items.question: Do I really need a lawyer for a minor-seeming crash in Belvedere?
items.answer: Even a low-speed collision on a street like Graham Avenue or Beach Road can cause injuries that don't fully show up until days later. Because Belvedere sees relatively few reported crashes, insurers may try to close claims quickly and cheaply, so it's worth having an independent attorney at least review the details before you settle anything.

items.question: Should I give the other driver's insurance company a recorded statement?
items.answer: It's generally best to avoid giving a recorded statement to the other side's insurer until you've spoken with an attorney. Anything you say can be used later to shift blame onto you under California's comparative fault rules, even if you were being polite or just trying to explain what happened.

items.question: What does LawProactive actually do?
items.answer: We're a free connection service, not a law firm — we simply match you with an independent personal injury attorney in our network who can evaluate your Belvedere car accident. There's no cost to get connected, and any attorney you work with typically handles the case on contingency, meaning no fee unless there's a recovery.
